$comment: Baseline verdict recorded by the original Node engine on a real government portal, before the pure-core extraction. The captures beside this file are that page with its identity removed — URLs, titles, selectors, text content and custom properties all replaced. None of that feeds the maths, which is why the verdict is unchanged; that it is unchanged is itself evidence the scrub touched nothing load-bearing. NOTE on the one deliberate re-baseline: earned moved 55.81 -> 55.80 when judged ratios began being computed FROM their counts (31/38 = 0.815789) instead of the rounded value restated beside them (0.816). Nothing measured changed. NOTE on A3: this capture predates the :focus-visible seeding fix, so its '80 of 80' finding is a known false positive of the old probe. It is pinned deliberately — captures without a `seeded` flag keep their original treatment, which is what makes this fixture a stable test of the scoring maths rather than of the probe. NOTE on the second deliberate re-baseline: 64.89 -> 65.20 when R2 (CSS logical properties) and M2 (prefers-reduced-motion) moved OUT of the 100 into the `extended` block, because DGA publishes neither and Figma cannot express either. Nothing measured changed and no finding changed — the two checks simply stopped counting toward a compliance score they had no authority behind. The arithmetic reconciles exactly: earned 55.80 - 0.99 (R2) - 2.00 (M2) = 52.81, available 86 - 3 - 2 = 81, and 52.82/81 = 65.20. NOTE on the band rename: "partial" -> "moderate" when the bands became ADOPTION levels rather than compliance verdicts. DGA publishes no passing score — it publishes a checklist and confirms conformance by formal review — so the tool no longer prints a compliance word it has no authority to print. The thresholds (90/75/60) and every number are unchanged; only the vocabulary moved, and the gate moved to verdict.readiness against DGA's own mandatory tier. NOTE on the third deliberate re-baseline: 65.20 -> 65.40 when Display md (36/44) and Display 2xl (72/90) were merged into the type ramp from rules/typography.md. The ledger had been extracted by walking COMPONENT pages, so ramp steps no component used were never captured. Exactly one finding disappeared — 'T2|minor|Font size 36px is off the DGA scale' — and every other signature is byte-identical, which is the evidence that this was a false positive against a legitimate DGA type step rather than an engine change. typography 9.71 -> 9.87, findings 53 -> 52. NOTE on the fourth deliberate re-baseline: 65.40 -> 64.78 when D1 (design system implemented) was added and took its 3 points from P1, 8 -> 5. Two attributable movements and nothing else: D1 reports n/a on this capture because it predates library detection — a pre-detection capture cannot tell 'no library' from 'never looked', which are opposite answers to DGA criterion 1 — so its 3 points leave the denominator (81 -> 78); and P1's lighter weight moves earned by 5x0.816 - 8x0.816 = -2.45 (52.98 -> 50.53). Nothing measured changed.
